% test_generateA429.m
% Test script for generateA429FromMsgArray function

clear; clc;

% 1. Create temporary output directory for generated files
testOutputDir = fullfile(pwd, 'test_output_dir');
if ~exist(testOutputDir, 'dir')
    mkdir(testOutputDir);
end

fprintf('1. Constructing test A429Message objects...\n');

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Message 1: Input message with regular fields + a 'pad1' field
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
msg1 = A429Message();
msg1.ioType = 'input';            % Expects: generateEncode='off', generateDecode='on'
msg1.msgName = 'PitchAngleMsg';
msg1.label1 = '1';
msg1.label2 = '0';
msg1.label3 = '2';                % Label = 102 OCTAL
msg1.sdiDefault = '0';            % Expects: sdiPresent='on', sdiVal='0'
msg1.ssmDefault = 'NORMAL';

msg1.data = cell(1, 3);

% Field 1: BNR Pitch Data
msg1.data{1} = struct( ...
    'name', 'PitchAngle', ...
    'dtype', 'BNR', ...
    'startBit', 11, ...
    'size', 14, ...               % Calculated endBitIndex = 24
    'resolution', '0.01', ...
    'unit', 'deg', ...
    'min', -180, ...
    'max', 180 ...
);

% Field 2: Padding (Should be SKIPPED by the function)
msg1.data{2} = struct( ...
    'name', 'pad1', ...
    'dtype', 'SPARE', ...
    'startBit', 25, ...
    'size', 4, ...
    'resolution', '1', ...
    'unit', '', ...
    'min', 0, ...
    'max', 0 ...
);

% Field 3: Discrete Field
msg1.data{3} = struct( ...
    'name', 'PitchValid', ...
    'dtype', 'DISCRETE', ...
    'startBit', 29, ...
    'size', 1, ...                % Calculated endBitIndex = 29
    'resolution', '1', ...
    'unit', '', ...
    'min', 0, ...
    'max', 1 ...
);

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Message 2: Output message testing ',' comma decimal in resolution
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
msg2 = A429Message();
msg2.ioType = 'output';           % Expects: generateEncode='on', generateDecode='off'
msg2.msgName = 'RollRateMsg';
msg2.label1 = 2;
msg2.label2 = 0;
msg2.label3 = 4;                  % Label = 204 OCTAL
msg2.sdiDefault = 'none';         % Expects: sdiPresent='off'
msg2.ssmDefault = 'NORMAL';

msg2.data = cell(1, 2);

% Field 1: Roll Rate (contains ',' separator in resolution)
msg2.data{1} = struct( ...
    'name', 'RollRate', ...
    'dtype', 'BNR', ...
    'startBit', 11, ...
    'size', 16, ...               % Calculated endBitIndex = 26
    'resolution', '0,05', ...     % Expects conversion to '0.05'
    'unit', 'deg/s', ...
    'min', -128, ...
    'max', 128 ...
);

% Field 2: Padding (Should be SKIPPED)
msg2.data{2} = struct( ...
    'name', 'pad2', ...
    'dtype', 'SPARE', ...
    'startBit', 27, ...
    'size', 3, ...
    'resolution', '1', ...
    'unit', '', ...
    'min', 0, ...
    'max', 0 ...
);

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Message 3: Bi-directional ("both") message
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
msg3 = A429Message();
msg3.ioType = 'both';             % Expects: generateEncode='on', generateDecode='on'
msg3.msgName = 'AirspeedMsg';
msg3.label1 = '3';
msg3.label2 = '1';
msg3.label3 = '0';                % Label = 310 OCTAL
msg3.sdiDefault = '1';
msg3.ssmDefault = 'TEST';

msg3.data = cell(1, 1);
msg3.data{1} = struct( ...
    'name', 'AirspeedVal', ...
    'dtype', 'BCD', ...
    'startBit', 11, ...
    'size', 12, ...               % Calculated endBitIndex = 22
    'resolution', '0.1', ...
    'unit', 'knots', ...
    'min', 0, ...
    'max', 500 ...
);

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Message 4: Tests mixed-case/spaces in ioType, numeric label digits, 
% and uppercase padding ('PAD_SPARE')
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
msg4 = A429Message();
msg4.ioType = '  INPUT  ';          % Trimming and case-insensitivity test
msg4.msgName = 'AltitudeMsg';
msg4.label1 = 0;                    % Numeric digit property
msg4.label2 = 2;
msg4.label3 = 7;                    % Label = 027 OCTAL
msg4.sdiDefault = 'none';           % Tests sdiPresent = 'off'
msg4.ssmDefault = 'NCD';

msg4.data = cell(1, 2);

% Field 1: Altitude Data
msg4.data{1} = struct( ...
    'name', 'BaroAltitude', ...
    'dtype', 'BNR', ...
    'startBit', 11, ...
    'size', 17, ...                 % Calculated endBitIndex = 27
    'resolution', '0.125', ...
    'unit', 'ft', ...
    'min', -1000, ...
    'max', 50000 ...
);

% Field 2: Uppercase Pad Field (Should be SKIPPED)
msg4.data{2} = struct( ...
    'name', 'PAD_SPARE_1', ...     % Case-insensitive 'pad' check
    'dtype', 'SPARE', ...
    'startBit', 28, ...
    'size', 2, ...
    'resolution', '1', ...
    'unit', '', ...
    'min', 0, ...
    'max', 0 ...
);

% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Message 5: Tests unrecognized ioType (fallback path) and multiple
% Discrete/BCD fields with no padding
% -------------------------------------------------------------------------
msg5 = A429Message();
msg5.ioType = 'invalid_type';       % Triggers warning & defaults to 'both'
msg5.msgName = 'SystemStatusMsg';
msg5.label1 = '3';
msg5.label2 = '5';
msg5.label3 = '7';                  % Label = 357 OCTAL
msg5.sdiDefault = '2';
msg5.ssmDefault = 'FWAR';

msg5.data = cell(1, 3);

% Field 1: Discrete status
msg5.data{1} = struct( ...
    'name', 'SystemFail', ...
    'dtype', 'DISCRETE', ...
    'startBit', 11, ...
    'size', 1, ...                  % Calculated endBitIndex = 11
    'resolution', '1', ...
    'unit', '', ...
    'min', 0, ...
    'max', 1 ...
);

% Field 2: Discrete warning
msg5.data{2} = struct( ...
    'name', 'WarningLight', ...
    'dtype', 'DISCRETE', ...
    'startBit', 12, ...
    'size', 1, ...                  % Calculated endBitIndex = 12
    'resolution', '1', ...
    'unit', '', ...
    'min', 0, ...
    'max', 1 ...
);

% Field 3: BCD Blower Speed
msg5.data{3} = struct( ...
    'name', 'BlowerSpeed', ...
    'dtype', 'BCD', ...
    'startBit', 13, ...
    'size', 12, ...                 % Calculated endBitIndex = 24
    'resolution', '1,0', ...        % Decimal comma conversion to '1.0'
    'unit', 'rpm', ...
    'min', 0, ...
    'max', 4000 ...
);

% Assemble full array including all 5 messages
msgArray = [msg1, msg2, msg3, msg4, msg5];

% 2. Run the function
fprintf('2. Calling generateA429FromMsgArray...\n');

try
    generateA429FromMsgArray(msgArray, testOutputDir);
    fprintf('\n[SUCCESS] Test run completed successfully without errors.\n');
catch ME
    fprintf('\n[FAILURE] Test execution failed:\n');
    rethrow(ME);
end
